title: Turning Actions and Qualities into Nouns
goal: Write a verb or an adjective as a noun, as formal writing does.
grammar: Turning Actions and Qualities into Nouns

items: I can turn a verb into a noun, such as *aumentar* into *el aumento*, in formal writing.
I can turn an adjective into a noun, such as *difícil* into *la dificultad*.
I can use a noun phrase after *debido a* instead of a whole clause.
